legend: The focally pigmented tumour has a nodular architecture and is circumscribed. Adjacent adrenal cortical tissue is present (upper left).
source: Alison Potter, Richard Scolyer and Stephen Mann

legend: Melan-A immunostain showing strong positive staining of the melanoma cells. Weak positive staining is present in the adjacent adrenal cortex (upper left).
source: Alison Potter, Richard A Scolyer and Stephen Mann

legend: The tumour is formed by pleomorphic polygonal and epithelioid cells. A lymphoid infiltrate is present at the periphery and focally within the tumour.
source: Alison Potter, Richard A. Scolyer and Stephen Mann

legend: Many of the melanoma cells include intracytoplasmic melanin pigment. Occasional mitoses are present.
source: Alison Potter, Richard A. Scolyer and Stephen Mann
